plan.title: SRC-CRE-036 — Add a second product row

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Change the default event type to RFQ as required by the case.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the product sheet is rendered.

args.goal: On the single-stage RFQ create screen, select the RFQ template if needed and add the first product CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB, confirming its Product Variant becomes Variant 1; set Quantity Requested to 10 and Delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001). Use the sheet's plus control to add a second row for AAC BLOCKS, set its quantity to 5 KG and its Delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001), and stop with both rows visible and the automatic title showing its updated value.

steps.note: Perform the distinct product selections, second-row action, field entry, and automatic-title observation that no dedicated catalog step can express directly.
Verify that the sheet contains exactly two product rows.
Verify the first row contains the requested cylinder product.
Verify the first product's automatically filled variant.
Verify the first row's delivery location.
Verify the second row contains AAC BLOCKS.
Verify the second row's requested quantity.
Verify the second row's delivery location.
